why: Rules frozen before live trading so the live record is a clean test. Do not change them after seeing live trades; any change becomes v4 with a new date.

setups.name: Big unlock
setups.rule: the unlock adds 25% or more of circulating supply

setups.name: First insider unlock + falling open interest
setups.rule: the token's first-ever insider unlock (under 25%), and open interest on the exchange we trade fell 10% or more from day -15 to day -8 (OI history: Binance, OKX, Gate only)

skipIf: price up 30% or more from the open 30 days before the unlock to the open on entry day (day -7)
no USDT perpetual for the real token on Binance, OKX, Bitget, Gate, Hyperliquid or KuCoin (MEXC never used)
the unlock is not confirmed (date, size or recipients unconfirmed by the project or two independent sources)

trade.entry: short at the 00:00 UTC open, 7 days before the unlock

passMark: After 30 live trades: average above +0.25R. Until then, treat it as a test.
approvedBy: Coach K in chat, 25 Nov 2026 10:08 Bangkok: "we must check all tokens have a perp/futures market that we can short or there is no point to focus on those unlocks ... with sanctions against MEXC we must avoid trading on that exchange"
changes: Same setups, entry, stop, target, exit and size as v3/v4.

MEXC is never used: not for trading, not for prices, and it doesn't count toward 'shortable'. Reason: FinCEN's order of 6 Nov 2026 cutting MEXC off from the US financial system over sanctions evasion (https://www.fincen.gov/system/files/2026-11/MEXC-Section-9714.pdf).
Allowed exchanges: Binance, then OKX, Bitget, Gate, Hyperliquid or KuCoin (the confirmed one with the most dollar volume over 7 days). Bybit is checked via CoinGecko, listing only.

Focus only on unlocks we can short: every unlock on the list is checked (scripts/shortable.py, data/shortable.json). Unlocks with no allowed perp for the real token are dropped from the brief, the Picks tab and the Unlocks tab (shown behind a click) and get no deep research. 'Can't short' is only recorded after every allowed exchange answered; otherwise it's 'unknown' and rechecked.
Same-token check unchanged from v4: within 15% of CoinGecko's price, or 5% of Binance/another exchange; over 10x off = a different asset (e.g. ADI = a stock perp).
evidenceOffBinance: Thin: the history test found 4 qualifying trades on Bybit/Gate-only tokens (+5.5R in total, research/exchange_test.json). Smaller exchanges can slip more than the 0.5% assumed.
